articles.title: Morgan Stanley debuts ether, solana exchange-traded products after bitcoin fund success
articles.snippet: The asset manager is offering low-cost ETH and SOL exchange-traded products after its bitcoin fund topped $381 million in assets.

articles.title: Binance makes fighting crypto crime more difficult, says new report
articles.snippet: The New York Times says a quiet change to Binance's compliance rules is forcing international law enforcement to navigate slow-moving government treaties to get user data.

articles.title: 1inch opens Aqua liquidity protocol across 13 chains
articles.snippet: Liquidity providers can keep assets in their own wallets, using one balance to back multiple positions without splitting capital across different pools.

articles.title: Live updates: Crypto climbs off worst levels as stock selloff is contained to AI names
articles.snippet: While the chipmakers continue their tumble, the DJIA is actually higher by more than 1%, led by Coca-Cola, Walmart, and Home Depot.

articles.title: U.S. Senate puts off crypto Clarity Act for now as it focuses limited bandwidth elsewhere
articles.snippet: The majority leader is pursuing floor time for unrelated bills as the crypto industry waits for its policy effort to get its chance for votes.
